title: mcp: name notRecorded in the record tools' descriptions, add one not-recorded ask question, and keep __search out of notRecorded
body:
repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjNq58cmHeqckjZkTFE

Filing gate: ③ follow-up of an accepted delivery (cross-repo-coordination.md rule 3). #35138 closes with PR #35408 (PR 5, its last table row). Its owed follow-up "PR 3b", recorded in #35138 comment 6983113781 as "not rows of its table" and "A later claim picks these up", would otherwise be lost with the card. This card carries it.

## What is owed (verbatim from 6983113781)

1. "A sentence in the `query_records`, `aggregate_records` and `get_record` tool descriptions that names `notRecorded` / `ifNotRecorded` (os-dev report 6979330524, open question; area note 6979387847 answered A)."
2. "One ask-card question for an object or field that is not recorded, in #35113's open ask cards."
3. "`__search` (the search companion key), on a `where` refused for another reason, is named in `notRecorded` (L1 note N1 in 6981423771). It is narrow, and the name is the caller's own string: skip it in `whereFieldNames` or list it in `ALWAYS_ADDRESSABLE_COLUMNS`."

## Where

- Items 1 and 3: `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` (tool descriptions; the `notRecorded` field-name collection). PR #35408 added `OBJECT_QUERY_SOURCE_DESCRIPTION` to the same two descriptions; item 1 sits beside it.
- Item 2: `docs/qa/scenarios/**` (the open ask cards #35113 names).

## Also noted by PR #35408 (Acceptance notes, not filed separately)

- The open citation grader (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts`, `SOURCE_LINE`) reads `Source:` / `来源：` but not `來源：` / `出典：`, which `source.line` now writes for zh-Hant and ja callers. No zh-Hant or ja ask question exists today; fold it into item 2's PR if one is added.

Suggested-grade: p3 · small follow-ups on a landed member, no user-visible defect today.
Dedupe: `notRecorded description` and `__search notRecorded` found only #35138.
